sources.title: luluw/Multilingual-E5-Large-Nep-GGUF · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Model This model is a 42.73% smaller version of intfloat/multilingual-e5-large, optimized for Nepali through vocabulary reduction using the trimming method. The original model has a vocabulary of 250,037 tokens. The trimmed model retains 16,384 tokens, significantly reducing model size and memory requirements.
